EC4: Patients with a history of gynecologic malignancy
EC5: History of allergic reactions [AND] attributed to compounds of similar chemical or biologic composition to misoprostol
EC6: Any cases converted to abdominal hysterectomy [OR] or other additional elective surgical procedures performed at time of abdominal myomectomy will be excluded from data analysis
EC7: Uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, ongoing [OR] or active infection [OR], symptomatic congestive heart failure [OR], unstable angina pectoris [OR], cardiac arrhythmia [OR], or psychiatric illness [OR]/social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements.
